  "helper_source": "def debt_to_gdp(ctx, col):
    """Engine!C20:G20"""
    if col == 'C':
        prior_debt = xl_eval(ctx, "Inputs!B6")
    else:
        prev_col = chr(ord(col) - 1)
        prior_debt = debt_to_gdp(ctx, prev_col)
    b22 = xl_eval(ctx, "Inputs!B22")
    b9 = xl_eval(ctx, "Engine!B9")
    inputs_col_17 = xl_eval(ctx, f"Inputs!{col}17")
    engine_col_10 = xl_eval(ctx, f"Engine!{col}10")
    inputs_col_16 = xl_eval(ctx, f"Inputs!{col}16")
    engine_col_16 = xl_eval(ctx, f"Engine!{col}16")
    if b22 == 1:
        choose1 = 0
        choose2 = b9
    elif b22 == 2:
        choose1 = b9
        choose2 = 0
    elif b22 == 3:
        choose1 = 0
        choose2 = 0
    else:
        choose1 = 0
        choose2 = 0
    term1 = xl_mul(choose1, engine_col_10)
    sum1 = xl_add(inputs_col_17, term1)
    div1 = xl_div(sum1, 100)
    numerator = xl_add(1, div1)
    term2 = xl_mul(choose2, engine_col_10)
    sum2 = xl_add(inputs_col_16, term2)
    div2 = xl_div(sum2, 100)
    denominator = xl_add(1, div2)
    prod = xl_mul(prior_debt, numerator)
    quotient = xl_div(prod, denominator)
    result = xl_sub(quotient, engine_col_16)
    return result",
